Endear (NPCs/endear.lua, procced by the Charm weapons): this is ENTHRALL, the proc SkaDemon timed at ~30s -- mind-control the faced mob, 6s cooldown; reverts to a normal world mob after (RTK uncast clears owner/target only). Control time is uniform in [duration, durationMax] = 20-25s: provisional tuning, not an archive value. Sits between Endear 15-20s and Fascinate 30-35s, matching SkaDemon's "longer than Endear but shorter than Fascinate".

Poet mind-control family (Spells/poet/endear.lua -- endear_poet/possess_soul_poet/charm_life_poet/align_follower_poet are four IDENTICAL copies of the same script, one per subpath rank). Same 300 mana / 6s aether as Enthrall (the NPC endear the Charm weapons proc), but control time is uniform in [duration, durationMax] = 15-20s: provisional tuning, shorter than Enthrall 20-25s and Fascinate 30-35s. Without these rows the poet spells had no verb at all and fell through to their spell_effects Buff archetype, i.e. silently did nothing.
